content: Idene usoi Ubarnaba nu Ushawurhu

Ra abika adɔsa ru Uantakiya umɔ abika asɔm Arherhu-Num abɔɔ nu abika amesuwe awu umɔ, Ubarnaba nu Usimiyon uwuruwi umbɔ iki iyisa Uwuku Ufĩrhã, nu Urhushiyu aka adzeku Usayirin nu Umanayen uwuruwi aka awu uwɛrhɛ uyɛrhe Uhiridu udzur ri ingwɛ̃nci, nu ikɛi Ushawurhu.
Umbɔ aka anu idzowe igɔng Uteijee na akpem igha ubin, Ipfu Isarsatangge ha igɔr umbɔ igɛ, <<Àka asɛnga umum Ubarnaba, nu Ushawurhu, umbɔ awu abi itseryɛ umum iki iyisa umbɔ aka itɔ̃.>>
Umbɔ aka akpem igha ubin na afɛn-Num amaa, umbɔ atsorhuwe abok nu umbɔ na adene umbɔ azĩmbɔ.
Ru Usayifuru
Ipfu Isarsatangge idene Uburhu nu Ubarnaba, umbɔ azĩmbɔ Usarhukiya, umɔ umbɔ atsĩ ukhukhɔɔ amɛ̃ azĩmbɔ Usayifuru.
Ivangyɛ umbɔ aka azĩ atsĩ Usarhami, umbɔ adzowe isarhe Arherhu-Num ra abã ifɛn-Num aki abi Uyahuda. Uyohana, umbɔ iki iyisa Umarku, awu nggu umbɔ anu iyike umbɔ ri itser.
Umbɔ aka azɛ̃rhã amaa umpfũwã hã kishoo aba atsĩ Upafo, umɔ umbɔ aka agbopu utsa Uyahudiya uwɔɔ uner igoka uwuku usɔm Arherhu-Num igbɛrangwĩ itsoka igburh Ubar-Joshuwa,
uwuruwi aka awu nggu ugomna Usarjiyu Uburhu, unga awu uner itsoi. Ugomna ayisu Ubarnaba nu Ushawurhu abee igũ Arherhu-Num.
Bɔr uner igoka ha Uarhima, itsoknga rikɔ ri idũ abi Uherhini, awe ri igamtsa nggu Ushawurhu nu Ubarnaba, abee ikɛn ugomna utsur unga adzowuka imangmang.
Mɔcɛ Ushawurhu, uwu umbɔ iki iyisa Uburhu, awu nggu Ipfu Isarsatangge, atsu asunga arhi Uarhima,
na agɛ, <<Ungo uwu ungwɛ̃ Undenggũ unggamtsak kishoo abin akika aze. Ungo uwu nggu ikpũ igbɛrangwĩ iyiki ibewe ukpekũ. Ungo udɛ̃ɛ̃ idzipu atsĩndĩ idzidzɛrhe uwu Uteijee umgbɔ uwu igbɛrangwĩ!

Icɛrɛ ubok Uteijee uwe ri igamtsa nggu ungo. Ungo uwuri iwu uner itapa, ungo usi ínyãɔ irhirhang ishaa unum ri ivanga.>> Kanying ibur nu uzĩ utsirkpɔ unga, unga anu ibibãrhã, abee uwuruwi aka ikpɔm ubok adarh unga.
Ivangyɛ ugomna aka anyã abinkɛ aka akorhe, unga adzowuka imangmang, ubinkutsu unga adzeidzeu akarhãrhã ri imesa ri itsi Uteijee.
Ru Uantakiya aki Upisidiya
Uburhu nu awɛrhu uzɛ̃rhãnga atsĩ ukhukhɔɔ amɛ̃ asoku Upafo azĩmbɔ Uperga ru abĩ Upamfirhiya, anangkɛ Uyohana Umarku aka abɔre umbɔ na abvui azĩã Urusharhima.
Asoku Uperga azĩmbɔ Uantakiya ru abĩ Upisidiya. Ru unum ukpuku uwoshambɔ atsĩ ru ubã ifɛn-Num asei.

Umbɔ aka amaa ivarhe ubvur Íkpem Umusa nu abvur abika asɔm Arherhu-Num, anggbaashi ubã ifɛn-Num hã adene itser ru umbɔ agɛ, <<Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn, umbi aba awembi ri irhɛm iyiki ififitayɛ umbi aka idzowe anera, umbi ama arherhe.>>
Uburhu aka abera adɛ̃ɛ̃, aberu uboknga na atirha arherhe agɛ, <<Umbi abimɛn abi Uisrairha, nu atsen abi Uyahuda nu abi iwei Unum, àka akpeto ru umum!
Unum uwu aner Uisrairha unga asɛng atokamɛn, aberuwe umbɔ ri ivangyɛ umbɔ aka awu ra abĩ Umasar, unga akũna umbɔ adzek umɔ nggu ijee iyiki igɔng.
Abima nggu umbɔ imɛka isɔka inaa ra arhum.
Unga aka amaa ivur abĩã utɔɔva ru Ukan'ana na adzowe ukam abĩmbɔ ra aner Uisrairha.
Akɛrɛ ha ayoke imɛka anaka anaa ni isɔka itɔ̃ɔ̃ (450). <<Akɛrɛ ha aka amaa, Unum aberuwe abɔɔ ru umbɔ awe abika atsu uvau utsɛku ivang uner uwuku usɔm Arherhu-Num Usamairha.
Mɔcɛ aner Uisrairha abee umbɔ atsime umbɔ uyɛrhe, Unum atsũwe Ushawurhu ungwɛ̃ Ukish, uner unang Ubanjami, uwuruwi aka awu uyɛrhe imɛka isɔka inaa.
Umbɔ aka atsũwe Ushawurhu, Unum atsime Udauda awu uyɛrhambɔ. Arherhu-Num ri itsi Udauda agɔr agɛ, <Umum ikpo Udauda ungwɛ̃ Ujesse, awu uner ikɔkmum, unga awuri ikorha abina kishoo aki amɛnmum.>
<<Awe ru unang utsak uwurɛ Unum aka akowe abi Uisrairha uwuku ufufɔrh, Uyesu, ru nyaka unga aka abemuwe.
Ivangyɛ Uyesu aka aba Uyohana aka adzowuka abi Uisrairha kishoo isarhe idzidzipa nu isorhu ubɔtisima.

Ivangyɛ itser Uyohana iki iyo imimaa, unga agɛ, <Umbi akaifɛrhkɔ ugɛ umum iwu ungamɔ? Umum isi iwemum unga hã. Ĩ'ĩ. Bɔr uwɔɔ ruwɔ aka iba ru undzingmum, uwuruwi arhi abadaknga umum isi ímɛ̃mum igarhuwe ake.>
<<Umbi abimɛn, anang Uibrahim, nu atsen abi Uyahuda nu abi iwei Unum ru umbi, awu ru umɛn umbɔ aka adene arherhe ififɔrh akɛrɛ.

Aner Urusharhima nu ayɛrhambɔ, umbɔ asi ihwɛngmbɔ ugɛ unga awu Uner Uwuku Ufɔrh ha. Umbɔ ikɛi asi ihwɛngmbɔ arherhe abika asɔm Arherhu-Num umbɔ iki ivarhe ubɛn unum ukpuku uwosha. Bɔr umbɔ atsu arherhe abika asɔm Arherhu-Num atsuafɛr, ri itsu uvau akpe ru Uyesu.
Umbɔ aka asi ikpombɔ uvau uwuku ufɛr unga, rimi hã umbɔ ngipu Ubirhatu umbɔ afɛre unga.
Ikikorhambɔ iki itsuifɛr kishoo ubinkpi umbɔ aka atsɛng ri itsinga, umbɔ acipuwe unga nu igãrhãmau ucucii, adzake unga ru ughwee utarh.
Bɔr Unum asoyika unga ra akpe ha.
Inuma irhɛirhɛ unga aka adzeyiwa ra abirabɛ aka adzeku Ugarhirhi adɔsa unga azĩ Urusharhima. Abirabɛ icɛrɛ umbɔ awu idekanga ra anera.
<<Umɛn idɛyiwa umbi Isarhe Iyiki Ize. Ubinkpi Unum aka abemuwe atokamɛn,
unga aka atsu ake atsuafɛr ru umɛn, angwɛ̃mbɔ, ri isoyiwe Uyesu ra akpe. Ru nyaka ngge iki itsɛng ru ubom ukpu uvaa ru Ubvur Abom igɛ,
Idzidzɛrhe Unum aka asoyiwe unga ra akpe ha utsur unga avɔ̃ɔ̃, arherhe ri írhɛm iyɛrɛ agɛ,

content.text: << <Umum iwuri idzaamum umbi usarkasar ídorh iyi idzidzɛrhe umum iki ibemuwe Udauda.>

content: Nggee unga agɔr ru ubom ukpɔɔ agɛ,
<<Udauda aka amaa itseryɛ Unum aka adzowe unga ri ivangnga. Mɔcɛ unga akpea, umbɔ adzake unga nggu atokanga, iyornga ivɔ̃ngge.
Bɔr uwuruwi Unum aka asoyiwe unga ra akpe asi ivɔ̃ɔ̃.
<<Umbi abimɛn, àka akpeto! Umɛn iwu nggimi ni idũwũwa umbi ugɛ atsũwe arhimmbi iwu ru ubok Uyesu.
Ru uboknga kishoo uwuruwi aka awe ru imangmang, umbɔ aka atsũwũkumbɔ arhimnga, akirakɛ Íkpem Umusa iki isi idɛ̃ɛ̃ itsũwũkũngge.
Àka angwɛ̃dzɛn utsur abin hã abvur abika asɔm Arherhu-Num aka arherhe akorhuke ru umbi. Agɔr agɛ,

content.text: << <Àka anyã, umbi abika ayɛi itser Unum!
umum iwuri ikorhu ubin ukpɔɔ ri inummbi,

content: Uburhu nu Ubarnaba aka azɛ̃rhã awuri idzidzek ru ubã ifɛn-Num hã, anera ashɔ̃rhã umbɔ ama aba arherhe arherhe ra abin hã ikɛi unum ukpuku uwosha iki iba.

Ivangyɛ umbɔ aka asoyiwe anera, abi Uyahuda arhɛrhɛ nu atsen abi Uyahuda aka adzipa atsĩ agbeyi abi Uyahuda adɔsu Uburhu nu Ubarnaba, nu umbɔ ikivarhambɔ adzowe umbɔ itsũwã umbɔ adɛ̃ɛ̃ aker ri imimutu Unum.
Unum ukpuku uwosha ukpɔɔ uku ukɔru uba irhɛɛ anera ru utepa idzek ikɔng inũ igosha Arherhu Uteijee.
Ivangyɛ abi Uyahuda aka anyã ikikɔng anera irhɛirhɛ, umbɔ agũ unyɛ̃ɛ̃ akarhãrhã, umbɔ adzuse igbɛrangwĩ nu ubinkpi Uburhu aka arherhe umbɔ atsĩmbɔ irhena unga.

Mɔcɛ Uburhu nu Ubarnaba asi igũmbɔ iwei, agɔr agɛ, <<Umbi abi Uyahuda imɛ̃ɛ̃ngge umɛn itirhi isarhe Arherhu-Num nggu umbi. Bɔr umbi aka akpɛ̃mbi na anyanga atsimbi asi imɛ̃mbi ikpo urhɛ uwu ugbagbaa, umɛn izĩ ra atsen abi Uyahuda.
Ubinkutsu ubin hã nukpɔ Uteijee aka atsuka umɛn agɛ,

content.text: << <Umum iki isɛng ungo uwu irhirhang ra atsen abi Uyahuda,
ugɛ umbi awuri ikũ ififɔrh azĩ atsĩ ri imimashu upfung.>

content: Ivangyɛ atsen abi Uyahuda aka agũ rimi, umbɔ agɔm anggɔm na akpoi Arherhu Uteijee, abirabɛ umbɔ aka asɛng umbɔ aka ikpo urhɛ uwu ugbagbaa adzowe imangmang.
Arherhu Uteijee atɛ̃rhã amaake abĩã kishoo.
Bɔr abi Uyahuda azɔka akatsɛrh abɔɔ abi iwei Unum abirabɛ umbɔ iki isaka adzowe umbɔ igɔng na abika agɔng abɔɔ ru utepa. Asoyikumbɔ uver ru umbɔ Uburhu nu Ubarnaba, awayiwe umbɔ ru abĩmbɔ.
Nggee umbɔ awashuwe uzurhu adakmbɔ umgbɔ uwu utsar ikpikpɛ̃ɛ̃ ra atsi abi utepa, na azĩmbɔ Uikoniya.
Nu angwɛ̃ imesa agɔm akarhãrhã, awu nggu Ipfu Isarsatangge.
